# LAMMPS Input Script for SiO2 NPT Quenching

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read data file

thermo          100

# NPT Quenching

run             10000

# Output

thermo_modify   line one

arguments.content:
# LAMMPS Input Script for SiO2 NPT Quenching

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

read_data       /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define the potential
pair_style      tersoff
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Define settings for NPT quenching
variable        Tstart equal 5000
variable        Tstop equal 1500
variable        P equal 0.0
variable        quench_rate equal 3.5

timestep        0.001

thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press vol density

fix             1 all npt temp ${Tstart} ${Tstop} ${quench_rate} iso ${P} ${P} 1.0

run             10000

unfix           1
